name: 94547 · Hercules, CA
findings: ZIP 94547 (Hercules) has 77 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94547 (Hercules) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 94547 (Hercules) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).
